title: Understanding Testing and Debugging in Software Engineering

blocks.text: In the world of software development, ensuring that applications work correctly is crucial. Testing and debugging are essential processes that help developers identify and fix issues before software is released to users.

blocks.markdown: Testing and debugging are two fundamental aspects of software engineering. Testing involves evaluating the software to ensure it meets specified requirements and functions correctly under various conditions. Debugging, on the other hand, is the process of identifying, isolating, and fixing problems or bugs within the software.

blocks.title: Key Definitions
blocks.text: A **fault** is a defect in the software code, a **failure** is the incorrect behavior of the software when executed, and an **error** is a human mistake that leads to a fault.

blocks.markdown: There are different levels of testing: unit testing, integration testing, and system testing. Unit tests focus on individual components, integration tests assess the interaction between components, and system tests evaluate the entire system's functionality.

blocks.title: Writing a Simple Unit Test
blocks.prompt: Let's create a unit test for a simple function that adds two numbers.

steps.text: Define a function called `add` that takes two parameters and returns their sum.
Write a unit test using a testing framework (e.g., Jest) to check if `add(2, 3)` returns `5`.

blocks.answer: The unit test checks if the function correctly adds two numbers, ensuring code coverage for that functionality.

blocks.markdown: When debugging, a systematic approach can help identify issues more effectively. Steps include reproducing the error, isolating the fault, and implementing a fix. Documenting the process can also aid in understanding and preventing future issues.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Always remember to distinguish between faults, failures, and errors in your answers, as this is a common area of confusion in exams.

points: Testing ensures that software functions correctly and meets requirements.
Debugging is a systematic process to identify and fix software issues.
